description.content: Returns the feed statuses for all the specified Feed IDs.

query.description: A unique ID returned from the Bulk Upload API, used for tracking the Feed File. Special characters must be escaped. (e.g., feedId: '...3456@789...' must be entered in the URL as '...3456%40789).
The object response to start with, where 0 is the first entity that can be requested. It can only be used when includeDetails is set to true.
The number of entities to be returned. It cannot be more than 50 entities. Use it only when the includeDetails is set to true.

header.description: (Required) The access token retrieved in the Token API call
A unique ID to track the consumer request by channel. Use the Consumer Channel Type received during onboarding
(Required) A unique ID which identifies each API call and used to track and debug issues; use a random generated GUID for this ID
(Required) Walmart Service Name

description.content: Returns the feed and item status for a specified Feed ID.

query.description: Includes details of each entity in the feed.
The object response to start with, where 0 is the first entity that can be requested. It can only be used when includeDetails is set to true.
The number of entities to be returned. It cannot be more than 50 entities. Use it only when the includeDetails is set to true.

description.content:
Get Feed Error Report API allows you to download a detailed error report for a submitted feed. 

Currently the API supports error report download for the following feeds: 
*   FITMENT_ACES 
*   FITMENT_PIES 

 This API returns a zipped .csv file, which contains line item level detailed error messages. For details and a sample, please refer to the guide section link below.
